verdicts.reason: A is the banner shrunk into a thin strip across the middle of the square. About 75% of the canvas above and below it is empty navy, 'Baby Toddler' is tiny and the dot clusters sit cramped against the edges, so nothing was rearranged for the new shape. B does restack the design, with the image band on top and a larger logo and 'BEDDING' lockup below. But the top-left dot grid sits over the image band, the side dot clusters float with no connection to anything, and the bottom ~55% of the canvas is dead space, so the layout is badly top-heavy. B is still the less bad of the two.
